Interest Rate on Deposits – Revised Directions for Small Finance Banks
 (245 kb)

RBI/2025-26/58
DOR.SFB.REC.31/16.13.218/2025-26

July 15, 2025

All Small Finance Banks
All Payments Banks

Madam / Dear Sir,

Interest Rate on Deposits – Revised Directions for Small Finance Banks

Please refer to the Master Direction – Reserve Bank of India (Interest Rate on Deposits) Directions, 2016 dated March 3, 2016, as amended from time to time.

2. On a review, it has been decided that Small Finance Banks shall be permitted to offer differential rates of interest on term deposits of ₹3 crore and above, subject to the conditions set out in the Annex. The rates offered shall be published on the bank’s website and shall not be changed during the contracted tenor of the deposit.

2.1 Banks shall have a Board-approved policy on the interest rates payable on bulk deposits, which shall be reviewed at least once a year.

2.2 The differential rates shall be uniform for all depositors within a bucket and shall not be negotiated on a case-by-case basis.

3. These directions shall come into force with immediate effect. Banks are advised to put in place the necessary systems and procedures before October 1, 2025.

4. The Master Direction stands amended to the extent indicated above. The updated Master Direction will be placed on the Reserve Bank’s website in due course.

Yours faithfully,

(Sunil Kumar Rao)
Chief General Manager
Department of Regulation

Annex

Conditions for offering differential interest rates on bulk deposits

(i) The bank shall maintain a schedule of rates for bulk deposits on its website.

(ii) Premature withdrawal penalties shall be disclosed upfront at the time of acceptance of the deposit.

Deposit sizeMaximum additional spread (bps)
₹3 crore to ₹10 crore50
Above ₹10 crore75
